pages.title: Starlight Imbuing
pages.content:
starlight imbuing - aka stardust imbuing is a mechanic that buffs an item's damage and increases every apply but there's a catch— every apply increases the cost by 10 stardust
which isn't good if you have basically no stardust
luckily— daily quests and weekly quests award stardust
so it shouldn't be too hard to max it out
which is level 10 btw

![Imbue Panek](data:image/webp;base64,)

stormlander v2.title: Stormlander V2
stormlander v2.content:
not to be confused with [[Stormlander]]

## Stormlander V2
the stormlander v2 is an electric weapon dealing 299 damage and when it hits a mob in the arena it strikes it as well as chains the lightning to the nearest mob
it's also the second version of the original with improved stats and a new image icon
